subject: Money
title: Fee Income
description: A quick win: understand Fee Income.

hook.text: US banks collected $34.7 billion in overdraft fees alone in one year. Fees are the quiet profit engine.

buildup.text: ATM fees, maintenance fees, wire fees, foreign transaction fees. Every service has a small toll attached.

discovery.text: Banks earn 30-40% of revenue from fees, not interest. The checking account isn't free—you pay in fees.

twist.text: Overdraft fees hit poorest customers hardest. Those with the least money pay the most to access it.

climax.text: Fee income is designed to be invisible. Small amounts, buried in statements, adding up silently.

punchline.text: The fee you don't notice is the most profitable.

quiz.question: What percentage of bank revenue comes from fees?
